LDA p_ptr                       \ the indices, from the top row down
    CLC
    ADC #2
    STA src + 1
    LDA p_ptr + 1
    ADC #0
    STA src + 2
    LDX #0
.byte
.src

    LDY sky_line
    STA (w_ptr),Y
    INX
    INY

candidates.new:
LDA p_ptr                       \ the indices, from the top row down
    STA src + 1
    LDA p_ptr + 1
    STA src + 2
    LDA sky_n                       \ the loop ends at X = 2 + count (C clear: row_ptr's high byte add)
    ADC #2
    STA cnt_ba44 + 1
    LDX #2                          \ src is p_ptr itself: X from 2 skips the column's header
.byte
.src
    LDA &FFFF,X                     \ self-modified: the column's indices
    TAY
.pix
    LDA &FFFF,Y                     \ self-modified: the pixel table
    LDY sky_line
    STA (w_ptr),Y
    INX
    INY
    CPY #8
    BCC same_cell
    DEC sky_bq                      \ the line below is the character row below's first
    JSR row_ptr
    LDY #0
.same_cell
    STY sky_line
.cnt_ba44
    CPX #&FF                        \ self-modified: 2 + the count
    BNE byte
candidates.summary: The byte loop's count as a self-modified CPX #(2+count) in place of DEC sky_n (3 cycles a byte), and src set to p_ptr itself with X starting at 2 (drops CLC/ADC #2/ADC #0); the CPX immediate set once a column with ADC #2 relying on C=0 after row_ptr. Alternative to candidate 2 (same lines).
candidates.equivalence: Inner loop reads LDA src+X with src=p_ptr, X=2+k: the same address p_ptr+2+k (and the same page crossings) as the old src=p_ptr+2, X=k. Old exit after n bytes (DEC sky_n from n to 0); new exit when X (incremented once a byte, INX before row_ptr which keeps X) equals 2+n, i.e. after n bytes; n>=1 here (count 0 branches to next_col before .placed) and n+2<=255 (body sprite columns are under 30 bytes). Setup: per column 25 cycles vs 22, i.e. +3 a column (0.167 columns a pass, from JSR row_ptr's 1.0 cycles/6). C on the ADC #2: row_ptr ends LDA sky_blk_hi,Y / ADC #0 / STA w_ptr+1 / RTS, and the blocks are in RAM (&31xx, &3Exx-&3Fxx) so the high add never carries: C=0. After the loop, X, A, Y are dead (next_col reloads Y and A; column reloads). sky_n is no longer counted down, so after sky_build it holds the last nonzero column's count instead of 0: every other reader (sky_check's and sky_draw's LDX sky_n after JSR sky_row, sky_geom's LDA sky_n) is preceded by its own write (sky_row's STA sky_n, sky_geom line 53), and sky_build is not run by the interrupt. Flags at the exit: BNE falls through with Z=1 to next_col, which sets its own (LDY #1).
candidates.relies_on: row_ptr leaving C clear (sky_blk_hi + carry never wraps past &FF); column counts <= 253; nothing reading sky_n = 0 after sky_build. hazel_c is &C200-&C2DD, ASSERTed below &C2FF: +2 bytes keeps it within the page, so no branch or code crosses a page; the self-modified reads' addresses are unchanged, so no page crossing moves. New label cnt_ba44 is unique.

LDA (p_ptr),Y
    SEC
    ADC #1
    CLC
    ADC p_ptr
candidates.new:
LDA (p_ptr),Y
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode: count + 1, then + 1 more by the carry

candidates.summary: next_col: p_ptr += count + 2 as INC A / SEC / ADC p_ptr in place of SEC / ADC #1 / CLC / ADC p_ptr (2 cycles, 1 byte). Independent of candidates 1 and 2.
candidates.equivalence: Old: A=count, (count+1+1) with CLC, then + p_ptr: A = p_ptr + count + 2, C its carry (correct while count+2 <= 255). New: INC A gives count+1 (no wrap for count <= 254), SEC/ADC p_ptr gives p_ptr + count + 2 with the same C into BCC same_page. V differs and is dead (INC sky_c / CMP follow); N/Z are overwritten before use. Both entries (BEQ next_col with A=0, and the loop's fall-through) reach LDY #1 / LDA (p_ptr),Y first, unchanged.
candidates.relies_on: column counts <= 253 (the old code needs the same). -1 byte in hazel_c, no page crossing moves (all within &C2xx).
